source.text: שִׁלְחוּ־כַ֥ר מֹשֵֽׁל־אֶ֖רֶץ מִסֶּ֣לַע מִדְבָּ֑רָה אֶל־הַ֖ר בַּת־צִיּֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: Send [a] lamb [to the] ruler of [the] land from Sela [toward the] wilderness, to the mountain of [the] daughter of Zion.

en.L: Send a lamb [to] the ruler of the land, from Sela [by way of the] wilderness, \q to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.
en.B: Send the ruler of the land his lamb, from Sela through the wilderness \q to the mountain of Daughter Zion.
en.R: People of Moab, send a lamb as a gift to the ruler of the land. \q Send it from Sela, across the desert, to Mount Zion, where the people of Zion live.

es.L: {{plural_you:Envíen|Enviad}} un cordero [al] gobernante de la tierra, desde Sela [por el] desierto, \q al monte de la hija de Sion.
es.B: {{plural_you:Envíen|Enviad}} al gobernante del país su cordero, desde Sela, a través del desierto, \q al monte de la hija de Sion.
es.R: Pueblo de Moab, {{plural_you:envíen|enviad}} un cordero como regalo al gobernante del país. \q {{plural_you:Envíenlo|Enviadlo}} desde Sela, a través del desierto, al monte Sion, donde vive el pueblo de Sion.

sw.L: Pelekeni mwana-kondoo [kwa] mtawala wa nchi, kutoka Sela [kwa njia ya] nyika, \q hadi mlima wa binti Sayuni.
sw.B: Mpelekeeni mtawala wa nchi mwana-kondoo wake, kutoka Sela kupitia nyikani \q hadi mlima wa Binti Sayuni.
sw.R: Enyi watu wa Moabu, mpelekeeni mtawala wa nchi mwana-kondoo kama zawadi. \q Mpelekeeni kutoka Sela, kuvuka jangwa, hadi mlima Sayuni, wanakoishi watu wa Sayuni.

decisions.choice: a lamb for the ruler: tribute sent to the king in Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Moab once paid Israel's king tribute in lambs and wool (2 Kings 3:4). Here Moab is told to send it again, to the ruler on Mount Zion, as a sign that it seeks his protection (verses 3-5).

decisions.choice: Sela: "the rock", a place in or toward Edom
decisions.reason: Sela means "rock". A place of this name lay in Edom (2 Kings 14:7); here it may be where Moab's refugees have fled, south of the Wadi of the Poplars (15:7). From there the gift must cross the wilderness to Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: send: an appeal to Moab
decisions.reason: The command is plural and addressed to Moab's leaders or people; the speaker is not named. It may be the prophet's advice or the words of Moab's own counselors.

decisions.choice: People of Moab ... as a gift ... where the people of Zion live
decisions.reason: Readable names whom the command is for (m3), says why the lamb is sent (m1), and explains "daughter of Zion" as the people of Zion, as elsewhere in Isaiah.

source.text: וְהָיָ֥ה כְעוֹף־נוֹדֵ֖ד קֵ֣ן מְשֻׁלָּ֑ח תִּֽהְיֶ֨ינָה֙ בְּנ֣וֹת מוֹאָ֔ב מַעְבָּרֹ֖ת לְאַרְנֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be like a bird fluttering, a nest sent away, will be the daughters of Moab [at the] fords of Arnon.

en.L: And it will be: like a fluttering bird, a nest cast out, \q [so] will the daughters of Moab be at the fords of [the] Arnon.
en.B: Like birds darting here and there, like nestlings thrown out, \q the daughters of Moab will be at the crossings of the Arnon.
en.R: The women of Moab will be like frightened birds pushed out of their nest. \q They will wander at the places where people cross the Arnon River.

es.L: Y sucederá que, como ave que revolotea, como nido echado fuera, \q [así] serán las hijas de Moab en los vados del Arnón.
es.B: Como pájaros que revolotean de un lado a otro, como polluelos echados del nido, \q estarán las hijas de Moab en los vados del Arnón.
es.R: Las mujeres de Moab serán como pájaros asustados echados de su nido. \q Andarán errantes por los lugares donde la gente cruza el río Arnón.

sw.L: Na itakuwa: kama ndege anayepigapiga mabawa, kiota kilichotupwa, \q [ndivyo] binti za Moabu watakavyokuwa kwenye vivuko vya Arnoni.
sw.B: Kama ndege wanaoruka huku na huko, kama makinda yaliyotupwa nje ya kiota, \q ndivyo binti za Moabu watakavyokuwa kwenye vivuko vya Arnoni.
sw.R: Wanawake wa Moabu watakuwa kama ndege walioogopa waliosukumwa nje ya kiota chao. \q Watatangatanga kwenye mahali ambapo watu huvuka mto Arnoni.

decisions.choice: the daughters of Moab: the women of Moab
decisions.reason: Most likely the women, fleeing with nowhere to rest. "Daughters" can also mean a land's towns and villages (Numbers 21:25), which would give the same picture of a scattered people.

decisions.choice: a nest sent away: young birds driven from the nest
decisions.reason: "Nest" stands for the young birds in it, scattered and helpless (compare 10:14).

decisions.choice: the fords of the Arnon: crossings on Moab's northern border
decisions.reason: The Arnon runs through a deep gorge into the Dead Sea. Its fords were the crossing points where refugees would gather.

decisions.choice: the places where people cross the Arnon River
decisions.reason: Readable explains "fords" and says the Arnon is a river.

source.text: הָבִ֤יאִי עֵצָה֙ עֲשׂ֣וּ פְלִילָ֔ה שִׁ֧יתִי כַלַּ֛יִל צִלֵּ֖ךְ בְּת֣וֹךְ צָהֳרָ֑יִם סַתְּרִי֙ נִדָּחִ֔ים נֹדֵ֖ד אַל־תְּגַלִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Bring counsel, make [a] decision; make like the night your shade in [the] middle of noon; hide [the] banished; [the] fugitive do not expose.

en.L: Bring counsel, make a decision; \q make your shade like the night in the middle of noon; \q hide the banished; do not expose the fugitive.
en.B: Offer counsel; give a ruling. \q Let your shade at midday be as dark as night. \q Shelter the outcasts; do not give away the one who flees.
en.R: Zion, give us advice. Make a fair decision. \q Protect us like deep shade that is as dark as night in the hot noon sun. \q Hide the people who have run away. \q Do not hand them over to their enemies.

es.L: Trae consejo, toma una decisión; \q haz tu sombra como la noche en medio del mediodía; \q esconde a los desterrados; no delates al fugitivo.
es.B: Danos consejo; dicta sentencia. \q Que tu sombra al mediodía sea oscura como la noche. \q Protege a los desterrados; no entregues al que huye.
es.R: Sion, danos un consejo. Toma una decisión justa. \q Protégenos como una sombra espesa que es oscura como la noche bajo el sol caliente del mediodía. \q Esconde a la gente que ha huido. \q No se la entregues a sus enemigos.

sw.L: Leta shauri, fanya uamuzi; \q fanya kivuli chako kama usiku katikati ya adhuhuri; \q waficha waliofukuzwa; usimfichue mkimbizi.
sw.B: Toa shauri; toa hukumu. \q Kivuli chako wakati wa adhuhuri kiwe giza kama usiku. \q Wahifadhi waliofukuzwa; usimsaliti anayekimbia.
sw.R: Ee Sayuni, tupe ushauri. Fanya uamuzi wa haki. \q Utulinde kama kivuli kizito chenye giza kama usiku wakati wa jua kali la adhuhuri. \q Waficha watu waliokimbia. \q Usiwakabidhi kwa adui zao.

decisions.choice: bring counsel ... hide: Moab's refugees plead with Zion
alternatives: the prophet urges Moab to shelter fugitives
decisions.reason: The commands are spoken to one woman, most naturally Zion (verse 1), by Moab's people asking for shelter; verse 4 continues "my outcasts". Some read them as the prophet's advice to Moab to take in Judah's refugees.

decisions.choice: bring: the scribes' reading, addressed to one woman
decisions.reason: The written text has a plural "bring"; the scribes' reading, followed here, is singular like the other commands. The next command ("make a decision") is plural in the Hebrew text.

decisions.choice: shade like night at noon: full protection
decisions.reason: In a hot land shade means shelter and safety (25:4; 32:2). Shade as dark as night at the brightest hour hides the refugees from any pursuer.

decisions.choice: Zion, give us advice
decisions.reason: Readable names the one addressed and the speakers (m1).

decisions.choice: do not give away
decisions.reason: The verb means to uncover or reveal: do not let pursuers find the fugitive.

source.text: יָג֤וּרוּ בָךְ֙ נִדָּחַ֔י מוֹאָ֛ב הֱוִי־סֵ֥תֶר לָ֖מוֹ מִפְּנֵ֣י שׁוֹדֵ֑ד כִּֽי־אָפֵ֤ס הַמֵּץ֙ כָּ֣לָה שֹׁ֔ד תַּ֥מּוּ רֹמֵ֖ס מִן־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let them sojourn among you, my banished [ones], Moab; be [a] hiding place for them from [the] face of [the] destroyer. For has come to an end the oppressor, has ceased destruction, have been finished [the] tramplers from the land.

en.L: Let my banished ones sojourn among you, Moab; \q be a hiding place for them from the face of the destroyer. \q For the oppressor has come to an end, destruction has ceased, \q the tramplers are gone from the land.
en.B: Let my outcasts from Moab stay among you as guests; \q be a shelter for them from the destroyer. \q For the oppressor will be gone, the ruin will stop, \q and those who trample others will vanish from the land.
en.R: Let us, the refugees from Moab, live with you. \q Hide us from the enemy who is destroying us. \q One day the cruel oppressor will be gone. The destruction will stop. \q The enemies who crush others will disappear from the land.

es.L: Que habiten contigo mis desterrados, Moab; \q sé para ellos un escondite ante el destructor. \q Porque el opresor ha llegado a su fin, la destrucción ha cesado, \q los que pisoteaban han desaparecido de la tierra.
es.B: Deja que mis desterrados de Moab vivan contigo como huéspedes; \q sé para ellos un refugio contra el destructor. \q Porque el opresor desaparecerá, la ruina terminará, \q y los que pisotean a otros se esfumarán de la tierra.
es.R: Déjanos vivir contigo a nosotros, los refugiados de Moab. \q Escóndenos del enemigo que nos está destruyendo. \q Un día el opresor cruel desaparecerá. La destrucción terminará. \q Los enemigos que aplastan a otros desaparecerán de la tierra.

sw.L: Waliofukuzwa wangu na wakae kwako kama wageni, Moabu; \q uwe mahali pa kujificha kwao mbele ya mharibu. \q Kwa maana mdhalimu amefikia mwisho, uharibifu umekoma, \q wakanyagaji wamekwisha katika nchi.
sw.B: Waache waliofukuzwa wangu kutoka Moabu wakae kwako kama wageni; \q uwe kimbilio lao mbali na mharibu. \q Kwa maana mdhalimu atatoweka, uharibifu utakoma, \q na wale wanaowakanyaga wengine watatoweka katika nchi.
sw.R: Turuhusu sisi, wakimbizi kutoka Moabu, tuishi kwako. \q Utuficha mbali na adui anayetuangamiza. \q Siku moja mdhalimu mkatili atatoweka. Uharibifu utakoma. \q Maadui wanaowaponda wengine watatoweka katika nchi.

decisions.choice: my outcasts, Moab: Moab's refugees speaking of themselves
alternatives: let my outcasts stay with you, Moab
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "my banished ones, Moab". Read with verse 3, Moab's refugees ask Zion to receive them. The ancient Greek translation reads "the outcasts of Moab", with the same sense. An older reading takes "Moab" as addressed: Moab is told to shelter God's outcasts.

decisions.choice: for the oppressor has come to an end: the end of the oppressor is certain
decisions.reason: The verbs are in the completed form, but the end of oppression is still to come; it leads into the promise of a just throne in verse 5.

decisions.choice: the oppressor: one who squeezes or presses
decisions.reason: The word occurs only here; it comes from a root meaning to press or wring out.

decisions.choice: will be gone / will stop
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the future for what is still to come (m2). Literal keeps the completed form.

decisions.choice: us, the refugees from Moab
decisions.reason: Readable states who "my outcasts" are (m1).

source.text: וְהוּכַ֤ן בַּחֶ֨סֶד֙ כִּסֵּ֔א וְיָשַׁ֥ב עָלָ֛יו בֶּאֱמֶ֖ת בְּאֹ֣הֶל דָּוִ֑ד שֹׁפֵ֛ט וְדֹרֵ֥שׁ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּמְהִ֥ר צֶֽדֶק׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be established in loyal love [a] throne, and will sit on it in faithfulness in [the] tent of David [one] judging and seeking justice and swift [in] righteousness.

en.L: And a throne will be established in loyal love, \q and [one] will sit on it in faithfulness in the tent of David, \q judging and seeking justice and swift [in] righteousness.
en.B: A throne will be made secure by loyal love, \q and a ruler will take his seat on it faithfully, in David's tent. \q He will judge, he will search out justice, and he will be quick to act in righteousness.
en.R: Then a king from David's family will rule with faithful love. \q He will sit on his throne and stay faithful. \q He will judge people fairly. He will look for justice and be quick to do what is right.

es.L: Y será establecido un trono en amor leal, \q y se sentará en él con fidelidad, en la tienda de David, \q uno que juzgue y busque el derecho y sea presto [en] la justicia.
es.B: Un trono quedará firme por el amor fiel, \q y un gobernante se sentará en él con fidelidad, en la tienda de David. \q Juzgará, buscará el derecho y será rápido en hacer justicia.
es.R: Entonces un rey de la familia de David gobernará con amor fiel. \q Se sentará en su trono y se mantendrá fiel. \q Juzgará a la gente con justicia. Buscará lo que es justo y será rápido para hacer lo correcto.

sw.L: Na kiti cha enzi kitaimarishwa katika upendo usiokoma, \q na [mtu] ataketi juu yake kwa uaminifu katika hema ya Daudi, \q akihukumu na kutafuta haki na mwepesi [katika] uadilifu.
sw.B: Kiti cha enzi kitaimarishwa kwa upendo usiokoma, \q na mtawala ataketi juu yake kwa uaminifu, katika hema ya Daudi. \q Atahukumu, atatafuta haki, naye atakuwa mwepesi kutenda kwa uadilifu.
sw.R: Kisha mfalme kutoka jamaa ya Daudi atatawala kwa upendo usiokoma. \q Ataketi katika kiti chake cha enzi na kubaki mwaminifu. \q Atawahukumu watu kwa haki. Atatafuta haki na kuwa mwepesi kutenda yaliyo sawa.

decisions.choice: a throne in the tent of David: a just king of David's line
decisions.reason: "Tent of David" is David's house and royal line (Amos 9:11). The promise recalls 9:6 and 11:1-5, where a son of David rules in justice and righteousness. The refugees' hope is not in Moab but in this throne.

decisions.choice: loyal love and faithfulness: the covenant virtues of the throne
decisions.reason: The pair of words describes God's own faithfulness (Exodus 34:6) and here the rule of the king who reflects it (Psalm 89:15).

decisions.choice: swift in righteousness: quick to do right
decisions.reason: The word for swift describes a skilled, ready person (Proverbs 22:29; Ezra 7:6). The king does not delay justice.

decisions.choice: a king from David's family ... faithful love ... what is right
decisions.reason: Readable explains "tent of David" as David's family, uses "faithful love" for loyal love, and says "do what is right" for righteousness.

decisions.choice: amor leal (L); amor fiel (B, R)
decisions.reason: Hesed is "amor leal" at L and "amor fiel" at B and R, as the Psalms note and the terms note set it. Book-wide choice for chapters 1-20.

decisions.choice: *ḥesed*: "upendo usiokoma"
decisions.reason: The settled word for loyal love (Psalms note), at every level.

source.text: שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ גְאוֹן־מוֹאָ֖ב גֵּ֣א מְאֹ֑ד גַּאֲוָת֧וֹ וּגְאוֹנ֛וֹ וְעֶבְרָת֖וֹ לֹא־כֵ֥ן בַּדָּֽיו׃ס

records.literal_gloss: We have heard [the] pride of Moab, proud very, its haughtiness and its pride and its arrogance; not right its empty boasts.

en.L: We have heard of the pride of Moab, very proud, \q its haughtiness and its pride and its arrogance; not right [are] its empty boasts.
en.B: We have heard of Moab's pride, proud beyond measure: \q its haughty airs, its pride, its overbearing fury. Its big talk comes to nothing.
en.R: We have heard how proud the people of Moab are. \q They are very proud and think they are better than everyone. They are arrogant and full of anger. But their boasting is empty.

es.L: Hemos oído del orgullo de Moab, muy orgulloso, \q de su altivez y de su orgullo y de su arrogancia; no [son] rectas sus jactancias vanas.
es.B: Hemos oído del orgullo de Moab, orgulloso sin medida: \q sus aires altivos, su orgullo, su furia desmedida. Sus bravuconadas no valen nada.
es.R: Hemos oído lo orgullosa que es la gente de Moab. \q Son muy orgullosos y se creen mejores que todos. Son arrogantes y están llenos de ira. Pero su jactancia está vacía.

sw.L: Tumesikia habari za kiburi cha Moabu, mwenye kiburi sana, \q majivuno yake na kiburi chake na ufidhuli wake; majisifu yake si sawa.
sw.B: Tumesikia juu ya kiburi cha Moabu, kiburi kupita kiasi: \q majivuno yake, kiburi chake, ghadhabu yake ya ufidhuli. Maneno yake makubwa ni bure.
sw.R: Tumesikia jinsi watu wa Moabu walivyo na kiburi. \q Wana kiburi sana na kujiona bora kuliko wengine wote. Wana majivuno na wamejaa hasira. Lakini majisifu yao ni bure.

decisions.choice: we have heard of the pride of Moab: Moab's pride is well known
decisions.reason: "We" may be Judah, answering Moab's plea, or the prophet with his hearers. Moab's pride is the reason for its fall (25:11; Zephaniah 2:8-10). Jeremiah 48:29-30 repeats this verse almost word for word.

decisions.choice: arrogance, empty boasts: overflowing insolence and idle talk
decisions.reason: The word for arrogance also means overflowing fury. "Not right its empty boasts" means its boasting has no substance and will not come true.

decisions.choice: the people of Moab ... think they are better than everyone
decisions.reason: Readable speaks of Moab's people and explains "haughtiness".

source.text: לָכֵ֗ן יְיֵלִ֥יל מוֹאָ֛ב לְמוֹאָ֖ב כֻּלֹּ֣ה יְיֵלִ֑יל לַאֲשִׁישֵׁ֧י קִיר־חֲרֶ֛שֶׂת תֶּהְגּ֖וּ אַךְ־נְכָאִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore will wail Moab for Moab, all of it will wail; for [the] raisin cakes of Kir-hareseth you will moan, only stricken.

en.L: Therefore Moab will wail for Moab, all of it will wail; \q for the raisin cakes of Kir-hareseth you will moan, utterly stricken.
en.B: So Moab will wail, Moab for itself, all of it wailing; \q you will moan, crushed and broken, for the raisin cakes of Kir-hareseth.
en.R: So the people of Moab will cry over their land. All of them will cry. \q You will groan in deep sorrow for the sweet raisin cakes of Kir-hareseth, which are no more.

es.L: Por tanto, Moab gemirá por Moab, todo él gemirá; \q por las tortas de pasas de Kir-hareset {{plural_you:suspirarán|suspiraréis}}, del todo abatidos.
es.B: Por eso Moab gemirá, Moab por sí mismo, todo él gimiendo; \q {{plural_you:suspirarán|suspiraréis}}, deshechos y quebrantados, por las tortas de pasas de Kir-hareset.
es.R: Por eso la gente de Moab llorará por su tierra. Todos llorarán. \q {{plural_you:Gemirán|Gemiréis}} con profunda tristeza por las dulces tortas de pasas de Kir-hareset, que ya no existen.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo Moabu ataomboleza kwa ajili ya Moabu, wote wataomboleza; \q kwa ajili ya maandazi ya zabibu kavu ya Kir-haresethi mtalia kwa huzuni, mkiwa mmepigwa kabisa.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo Moabu ataomboleza, Moabu kwa ajili yake mwenyewe, wote wakiomboleza; \q mtalia, mkiwa mmepondwa na kuvunjika, kwa ajili ya maandazi ya zabibu kavu ya Kir-haresethi.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo watu wa Moabu watalilia nchi yao. Wote watalia. \q Mtaugua kwa huzuni kuu kwa ajili ya maandazi matamu ya zabibu kavu ya Kir-haresethi, ambayo hayapo tena.

decisions.choice: raisin cakes of Kir-hareseth: the city's rich produce, lost
decisions.reason: Raisin cakes were a delicacy and used at feasts (2 Samuel 6:19; Hosea 3:1). Jeremiah 48:31 has "the men of Kir-heres", and some take this word as "foundations". Kir-hareseth is Kir of Moab (15:1; 2 Kings 3:25).

decisions.choice: you will moan, utterly stricken: Moab addressed
decisions.reason: The verb turns to address Moab's people directly. "Only stricken" means wholly struck down.

decisions.choice: sweet ... which are no more
decisions.reason: Readable says why they grieve for raisin cakes: the harvest is lost (verses 8-10).

source.text: כִּ֣י שַׁדְמוֹת֩ חֶשְׁבּ֨וֹן אֻמְלָ֜ל גֶּ֣פֶן שִׂבְמָ֗ה בַּעֲלֵ֤י גוֹיִם֙ הָלְמ֣וּ שְׂרוּקֶּ֔יהָ עַד־יַעְזֵ֥ר נָגָ֖עוּ תָּ֣עוּ מִדְבָּ֑ר שְׁלֻ֣חוֹתֶ֔יהָ נִטְּשׁ֖וּ עָ֥בְרוּ יָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For [the] terraces of Heshbon languish, [the] vine of Sibmah; [the] lords of [the] nations have struck down its choice branches; to Jazer they reached, they wandered [into the] wilderness; its shoots spread out, they crossed over [the] sea.

en.L: For the terraced fields of Heshbon languish, the vine of Sibmah; the lords of the nations have struck down its choice branches; \q to Jazer they reached; they wandered [into the] wilderness; \q its shoots spread out; they crossed over [the] sea.
en.B: The terraces of Heshbon wilt, and the vine of Sibmah with them; the masters of the nations have beaten down its choicest stems, \q stems that once stretched to Jazer and wandered into the wilderness, \q whose runners spread out and crossed the sea.
en.R: The fields around Heshbon are dying, and the grapevines of Sibmah are dying too. Rulers from other nations have broken down the best vines. \q Those vines once grew as far as the town of Jazer and out into the desert. \q They spread so far that they reached across the Dead Sea.

es.L: Porque los campos en terrazas de Hesbón languidecen, la vid de Sibma; los señores de las naciones han derribado sus mejores sarmientos; \q hasta Jazer llegaban; se extendían por el desierto; \q sus brotes se esparcían; pasaban más allá del mar.
es.B: Las terrazas de Hesbón se marchitan, y con ellas la vid de Sibma; los amos de las naciones han abatido sus mejores tallos, \q tallos que antes llegaban hasta Jazer y se extendían por el desierto, \q cuyos sarmientos se esparcían y cruzaban el mar.
es.R: Los campos alrededor de Hesbón se están muriendo, y también las vides de Sibma. Gobernantes de otras naciones han destrozado las mejores vides. \q Antes esas vides crecían hasta el pueblo de Jazer y hasta el desierto. \q Se extendían tanto que llegaban al otro lado del mar Muerto.

sw.L: Kwa maana mashamba ya Heshboni yamenyauka, mzabibu wa Sibma; wakuu wa mataifa wameyavunja matawi yake bora; \q yalifika hata Yazeri; yalitangatanga [hadi] nyikani; \q machipukizi yake yalienea; yalivuka [hadi] bahari.
sw.B: Mashamba ya Heshboni yananyauka, na mzabibu wa Sibma pamoja nayo; mabwana wa mataifa wameyaangusha matawi yake bora kabisa, \q matawi yaliyowahi kufika hadi Yazeri na kutambaa mpaka nyikani, \q ambayo machipukizi yake yalienea na kuvuka bahari.
sw.R: Mashamba yanayozunguka Heshboni yanakufa, na mizabibu ya Sibma inakufa pia. Watawala wa mataifa mengine wameivunja mizabibu iliyo bora. \q Mizabibu hiyo iliwahi kuota mpaka mji wa Yazeri na hata jangwani. \q Ilienea mbali sana hata ikavuka Bahari ya Chumvi.

decisions.choice: the lords of the nations have struck down its choice branches
alternatives: its choice wine overcame the lords of the nations
decisions.reason: The line can be read either way round: the foreign rulers struck down Sibmah's vines, or Sibmah's choice wine "struck down" (made drunk) the lords of the nations, a sign of its fame. In the context of ruin the first is taken here.

decisions.choice: Sibmah, Jazer, the sea: Moab's famous vineyards
decisions.reason: Sibmah, near Heshbon, was known for its vines (Numbers 32:38). The vine spreading to Jazer in the north, into the eastern wilderness and across the sea, most likely the Dead Sea, pictures how far its vineyards and fame reached. Jeremiah 48:32 repeats the picture.

decisions.choice: the Dead Sea
decisions.reason: Readable names the sea, following m2.

decisions.choice: "Bahari ya Chumvi" for the Dead Sea
decisions.reason: Readable names the sea, as the English does; "Bahari ya Chumvi" is the Pentateuch's name for it (Genesis 14:3).

source.text: עַל־כֵּ֡ן אֶבְכֶּ֞ה בִּבְכִ֤י יַעְזֵר֙ גֶּ֣פֶן שִׂבְמָ֔ה אֲרַיָּ֨וֶךְ֙ דִּמְעָתִ֔י חֶשְׁבּ֖וֹן וְאֶלְעָלֵ֑ה כִּ֧י עַל־קֵיצֵ֛ךְ וְעַל־קְצִירֵ֖ךְ הֵידָ֥ד נָפָֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore I weep with [the] weeping of Jazer [for the] vine of Sibmah; I drench you [with] my tears, Heshbon and Elealeh, for on your summer fruit and on your harvest [the] shout has fallen.

en.L: Therefore I weep with the weeping of Jazer [for] the vine of Sibmah; \q I drench you [with] my tears, Heshbon and Elealeh, \q for on your summer fruit and on your harvest the shout has fallen.
en.B: That is why I weep along with Jazer for the vine of Sibmah; \q my tears pour over you, Heshbon and Elealeh, \q for the glad shout over your ripe fruit and your harvest has died away.
en.R: So I cry for the grapevines of Sibmah, just as the people of Jazer cry. \q Heshbon and Elealeh, my tears soak you. \q People used to shout with joy when they gathered fruit and grain. Now that shouting has stopped.

es.L: Por tanto, lloro con el llanto de Jazer [por] la vid de Sibma; \q te riego [con] mis lágrimas, Hesbón y Eleale, \q porque sobre tus frutos de verano y sobre tu cosecha ha caído el grito.
es.B: Por eso lloro junto con Jazer por la vid de Sibma; \q mis lágrimas se derraman sobre ti, Hesbón y Eleale, \q porque el grito de alegría por tus frutos maduros y por tu cosecha se ha apagado.
es.R: Por eso lloro por las vides de Sibma, como llora la gente de Jazer. \q Lloro tanto por Hesbón y Eleale que mis lágrimas las empapan. \q La gente gritaba de alegría cuando recogía la fruta y el grano. Ahora esos gritos se han acabado.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo ninalia kwa kilio cha Yazeri [kwa ajili ya] mzabibu wa Sibma; \q ninakulowanisha [kwa] machozi yangu, Heshboni na Eleale, \q kwa maana juu ya matunda yako ya kiangazi na juu ya mavuno yako kelele imeanguka.
sw.B: Ndiyo sababu ninalia pamoja na Yazeri kwa ajili ya mzabibu wa Sibma; \q machozi yangu yanakumwagikia, Heshboni na Eleale, \q kwa maana shangwe juu ya matunda yako yaliyoiva na mavuno yako imekoma.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo ninailia mizabibu ya Sibma, kama watu wa Yazeri wanavyolia. \q Heshboni na Eleale, machozi yangu yanawalowanisha. \q Watu walizoea kupiga kelele za furaha walipovuna matunda na nafaka. Sasa kelele hizo zimekoma.

decisions.choice: the shout has fallen: the harvest cry has ended
alternatives: a war cry has fallen on your summer fruit and harvest
decisions.reason: The word is the shout of the grape treaders (verse 10; Jeremiah 25:30). "Has fallen" most likely means that the joyful shout has stopped. It may instead mean that a shout, the enemy's war cry, has fallen on the harvest (Jeremiah 48:32 has "the destroyer has fallen").

decisions.choice: I weep: the speaker shares Moab's grief
decisions.reason: As in 15:5, the speaker mourns for Moab. In verse 10 God says "I have made the shout cease", so the grief may be the prophet's or God's own (Jeremiah 48:31-36).

decisions.choice: summer fruit and harvest: the late fruit and the grain
decisions.reason: Summer fruit is the ripe fruit of late summer, figs and grapes (Amos 8:1-2); the harvest may be the grain or the vintage.

decisions.choice: People used to shout with joy
decisions.reason: Readable explains the harvest shout (m1).

source.text: וְנֶאֱסַ֨ף שִׂמְחָ֤ה וָגִיל֙ מִן־הַכַּרְמֶ֔ל וּבַכְּרָמִ֥ים לֹֽא־יְרֻנָּ֖ן לֹ֣א יְרֹעָ֑ע יַ֗יִן בַּיְקָבִ֛ים לֹֽא־יִדְרֹ֥ךְ הַדֹּרֵ֖ךְ הֵידָ֥ד הִשְׁבַּֽתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: And are gathered away gladness and joy from the fruitful land, and in the vineyards not is sung, not is shouted; wine in the presses not treads the treader; [the] shout I have made to cease.

en.L: And gladness and joy are gathered away from the fruitful land, \q and in the vineyards there is no singing, there is no shouting; \q wine in the presses the treader does not tread; the shout I have made to cease.
en.B: Gladness and delight are gathered up and gone from the garden land. \q In the vineyards there is no singing and no cheering; \q the treader treads no wine in the winepresses. I have silenced the harvest shout.
en.R: There is no more joy or gladness in the orchards. \q The vineyards are quiet, with no songs and no cheering. \q No one crushes grapes to make wine anymore. I have stopped their happy shouting.

es.L: Y se han retirado la alegría y el regocijo del campo fértil, \q y en las viñas no se canta, no se grita de júbilo; \q vino en los lagares no pisa el pisador; el grito he hecho cesar.
es.B: La alegría y el gozo se han ido de la tierra de huertos. \q En las viñas no hay cantos ni vítores; \q el pisador ya no pisa vino en los lagares. He hecho callar el grito de la vendimia.
es.R: Ya no hay alegría ni gozo en los huertos. \q Las viñas están en silencio, sin cantos ni vítores. \q Ya nadie pisa uvas para hacer vino. He hecho callar sus gritos de alegría.

sw.L: Na furaha na shangwe zimeondolewa katika shamba lenye rutuba, \q na katika mashamba ya mizabibu hakuimbwi, hakupigwi kelele; \q divai katika mashinikizo mkanyagaji haikanyagi; kelele nimeikomesha.
sw.B: Furaha na shangwe zimekusanywa na kutoweka katika nchi ya bustani. \q Katika mashamba ya mizabibu hakuna kuimba wala kushangilia; \q mkanyagaji hakanyagi divai katika mashinikizo. Nimeinyamazisha kelele ya mavuno.
sw.R: Hakuna tena furaha wala shangwe katika bustani za matunda. \q Mashamba ya mizabibu yako kimya, bila nyimbo wala kushangilia. \q Hakuna anayekanyaga zabibu kutengeneza divai tena. Nimekomesha kelele zao za furaha.

decisions.choice: the fruitful land: orchard and garden country
decisions.reason: The word is the same as the name Carmel, but here it means fertile land planted with fruit trees and vines (10:18; 29:17), not Mount Carmel.

decisions.choice: treading in the presses: making wine
decisions.reason: Grapes were crushed by foot in a pressing floor cut in rock, with singing and shouts (Judges 9:27; Jeremiah 25:30).

decisions.choice: I have made to cease: God speaks
decisions.reason: The "I" who ends the shout is God, who brings the judgment. The verb is in the completed form, as in a vision of what is certain.

decisions.choice: crushes grapes to make wine
decisions.reason: Readable explains treading (m2).

source.text: עַל־כֵּן֙ מֵעַ֣י לְמוֹאָ֔ב כַּכִּנּ֖וֹר יֶֽהֱמ֑וּ וְקִרְבִּ֖י לְקִ֥יר חָֽרֶשׂ׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore my inward parts for Moab like [a] harp sound, and my inner being for Kir-heres.

en.L: Therefore my inward parts sound like a lyre for Moab, \q and my inner being for Kir-heres.
en.B: So deep within me I moan for Moab like a plucked lyre, \q and my inmost being moans for Kir-heres.
en.R: My heart aches for Moab. It makes a sad sound, like the music of a harp. \q Deep inside I mourn for Kir-heres.

es.L: Por tanto, mis entrañas resuenan como una lira por Moab, \q y mi interior por Kir-heres.
es.B: Por eso, en lo más hondo de mí, gimo por Moab como una lira pulsada, \q y mi ser más íntimo gime por Kir-heres.
es.R: Me duele el corazón por Moab. Hace un sonido triste, como la música de un arpa. \q En lo más hondo de mí lloro por Kir-heres.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo matumbo yangu yanalia kama kinubi kwa ajili ya Moabu, \q na moyo wangu kwa ajili ya Kir-heresi.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo ndani yangu ninaugua kwa ajili ya Moabu kama kinubi kinachopigwa, \q na ndani kabisa ya nafsi yangu ninaugua kwa ajili ya Kir-heresi.
sw.R: Moyo wangu unauma kwa ajili ya Moabu. Unatoa sauti ya huzuni, kama muziki wa kinubi. \q Ndani yangu ninaomboleza kwa ajili ya Kir-heresi.

decisions.choice: my inward parts sound like a lyre: deep grief
decisions.reason: The inward parts are the seat of feeling. Their sound is compared to the low, throbbing note of a stringed lyre (compare Jeremiah 48:36, which uses flutes).

decisions.choice: Kir-heres: Kir-hareseth
decisions.reason: A shorter form of the name in verse 7, Moab's capital (15:1); Jeremiah 48:31, 36 has the same form.

decisions.choice: lyre
decisions.reason: The instrument was a small stringed lyre; Readable says "harp", the more familiar word.

decisions.choice: moans
decisions.reason: Balanced repeats the verb in the second line, which the Hebrew leaves understood.

source.text: וְהָיָ֧ה כִֽי־נִרְאָ֛ה כִּֽי־נִלְאָ֥ה מוֹאָ֖ב עַל־הַבָּמָ֑ה וּבָ֧א אֶל־מִקְדָּשׁ֛וֹ לְהִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל וְלֹ֥א יוּכָֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be, when it appears, when has wearied itself Moab on the high place and comes to its sanctuary to pray, and not it will prevail.

en.L: And it will be, when Moab appears, when it wearies itself on the high place \q and comes to its sanctuary to pray, it will not prevail.
en.B: Moab will come before its god and tire itself out at the high place; \q it will go into its sanctuary to pray, and it will accomplish nothing.
en.R: The people of Moab will go to their hilltop altars and worship until they are worn out. \q They will go into their temple to pray. But it will do them no good.

es.L: Y sucederá que, cuando Moab se presente, cuando se fatigue sobre el lugar alto \q y venga a su santuario a orar, no prevalecerá.
es.B: Moab se presentará ante su dios y se cansará en el lugar alto; \q entrará en su santuario a orar, y no conseguirá nada.
es.R: La gente de Moab irá a sus altares en las colinas y adorará hasta quedar agotada. \q Entrará en su templo a orar. Pero no le servirá de nada.

sw.L: Na itakuwa, Moabu atakapojitokeza, atakapojichosha juu ya mahali pa juu \q na kuja patakatifu pake kuomba, hatashinda.
sw.B: Moabu atakuja mbele ya mungu wake na kujichosha mahali pa juu; \q ataingia patakatifu pake kuomba, wala hatafanikisha chochote.
sw.R: Watu wa Moabu watakwenda kwenye madhabahu zao vilimani na kuabudu mpaka wachoke. \q Wataingia hekaluni mwao kuomba. Lakini haitawasaidia kitu.

decisions.choice: appears: comes before a god in worship
decisions.reason: The verb "appear" is used of coming before God at a shrine (1:12; Exodus 23:15). Moab's god was Chemosh (Numbers 21:29; 1 Kings 11:7).

decisions.choice: it will not prevail: its prayers gain nothing
decisions.reason: Moab's weeping at the high place (15:2) and its prayers in its sanctuary cannot turn back the disaster. The repeated "when" may also be a doubled emphasis, "even when".

decisions.choice: before its god
decisions.reason: Balanced says before whom Moab appears (m1).

source.text: זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־מוֹאָ֖ב מֵאָֽז׃

records.literal_gloss: This [is] the word which spoke Yahweh concerning Moab from then.

en.L: This [is] the word that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke concerning Moab from of old.
en.B: Such was the word {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke about Moab in earlier days.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said about Moab long ago.

es.L: Esta [es] la palabra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} habló acerca de Moab desde antaño.
es.B: Esta fue la palabra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} pronunció sobre Moab en días pasados.
es.R: Esto es lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo hace mucho tiempo acerca de Moab.

sw.L: Hili [ndilo] neno ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alisema kuhusu Moabu tangu zamani.
sw.B: Hilo ndilo neno ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alisema juu ya Moabu siku za kwanza.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alilosema kuhusu Moabu zamani.

decisions.choice: from then: in the past, earlier
decisions.reason: The oracle of 15:1-16:12 is called a word spoken before; verse 14 adds a new word for "now". It may have been given earlier in Isaiah's ministry, or be an older word about Moab taken up here; Jeremiah 48 uses much of it again.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָה֮ לֵאמֹר֒ בְּשָׁלֹ֤שׁ שָׁנִים֙ כִּשְׁנֵ֣י שָׂכִ֔יר וְנִקְלָה֙ כְּב֣וֹד מוֹאָ֔ב בְּכֹ֖ל הֶהָמ֣וֹן הָרָ֑ב וּשְׁאָ֥ר מְעַ֛ט מִזְעָ֖ר ל֥וֹא כַבִּֽיר׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And now has spoken Yahweh, saying, in three years like [the] years of [a] hired worker, and will be lightly esteemed the glory of Moab with all the multitude the great, and [the] remnant [will be] little, few, not mighty.

en.L: And now {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken, saying: Within three years, like the years of a hired worker, the glory of Moab will be held in contempt, with all [its] great multitude, and the remnant [will be] small, few, not mighty.
en.B: But now {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken: Within three years, counted as a hired worker counts them, the glory of Moab with all its great throng will be treated as nothing, and those left over will be a handful, without strength.
en.R: But now {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: In exactly three years, Moab's glory will be gone. All its crowds of people will be looked down on. Only a few weak people will be left.

es.L: Y ahora {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hablado, diciendo: Dentro de tres años, como los años de un jornalero, la gloria de Moab será tenida en poco, con toda [su] gran multitud, y el remanente [será] pequeño, escaso, sin fuerza.
es.B: Pero ahora {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hablado: Dentro de tres años, contados como los cuenta un jornalero, la gloria de Moab con toda su gran multitud será tenida por nada, y los que queden serán un puñado, sin fuerza.
es.R: Pero ahora {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice: Dentro de tres años exactos, la gloria de Moab desaparecerá. Todas sus multitudes serán despreciadas. Solo quedarán unos pocos, y sin fuerzas.

sw.L: Na sasa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema, akisema: Katika miaka mitatu, kama miaka ya mtu wa kuajiriwa, utukufu wa Moabu utadharauliwa, pamoja na umati [wake] wote mkubwa, na mabaki [watakuwa] wachache, kidogo, wasio na nguvu.
sw.B: Lakini sasa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema: Kabla ya miaka mitatu kupita, ikihesabiwa kama mfanyakazi wa mshahara anavyoihesabu, utukufu wa Moabu pamoja na umati wake wote mkubwa utahesabiwa kuwa si kitu, na watakaobaki watakuwa wachache tu, wasio na nguvu.
sw.R: Lakini sasa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anasema: Baada ya miaka mitatu kamili, utukufu wa Moabu utatoweka. Umati wake wote wa watu utadharauliwa. Watu wachache tu dhaifu ndio watakaobaki.

decisions.choice: like the years of a hired worker: exactly counted
decisions.reason: A hired man works for a fixed term and counts the days; the time will be no longer than stated (21:16).

decisions.choice: the glory of Moab will be held in contempt: its honor made light
decisions.reason: "Glory" is from the root "heavy"; it will become "light", a play on words. The glory is Moab's wealth, power and many people.

decisions.choice: the remnant small, few, not mighty: a weak handful left
decisions.reason: Moab is not wholly wiped out, but its survivors will be few and weak.

decisions.choice: In exactly three years ... will be gone
decisions.reason: Readable explains "like the years of a hired worker" (m1) and says plainly what contempt for Moab's glory means.
